metric: CloudTrail eventTime to independently verified quarantine
attacker_key_probe: Independent attacker-credential probes. KMS DescribeKey tests authorization approximately every 100ms from attack time until a recognized authorization denial. STS GetCallerIdentity tests credential authentication approximately every 100ms from action discovery until a recognized authentication denial. Neither probe stops merely because the other observes a denial. Observation ends when both denials are observed, the configured post-action observation window expires, or the overall timeout is reached. Outcomes and timestamps are recorded separately.
